beginner.title: Get started with Bloomberg Terminal
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Bloomberg Terminal, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Read a quote and a chart
beginner.outcome: You can: understand prices and charts
beginner.practice: Build a watchlist of five instruments

beginner.title: Fundamentals and news
beginner.outcome: You can: find company and economic information
beginner.practice: Compare two companies on three ratios

intermediate.title: Screens and alerts
intermediate.practice: Build a screen and set two alerts

intermediate.title: Export to your model
intermediate.outcome: You can: move data into your analysis
intermediate.practice: Pull data into a spreadsheet model

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Bloomberg Terminal
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Bloomberg Terminal distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Bloomberg Terminal
expert.outcome: You can: use Bloomberg Terminal's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Risk-aware use
expert.outcome: You can: use data responsibly in decisions
expert.practice: Write a checklist for using Bloomberg Terminal data in decisions

expert.title: Integrate Bloomberg Terminal into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Bloomberg Terminal with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Bloomberg Terminal to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Bloomberg Terminal well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Bloomberg Terminal" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
